topic: Updating Estonia's visibility factor and data fields
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on adjusting the historical visibility factor for Estonia to 15.7. A key discussion point was whether this change required recalculating and reaggregating the model results using the new factor.

Later, [me] updated the data view by adding several nullable fields related to impressions and dwell time:
* `viewable_flow_impressions` (UInt32)
* `viewable_dwell_impressions` (UInt32)
* `viewed_flow_impressions` (UInt32)
* `viewed_dwell_impressions` (UInt32)
* `visibility_factor` (Float32)
decisions: The visibility factor for Estonia was set to 15.7.
[me] added five new nullable fields related to impressions and dwell time to the data view.
action_items: Confirm if the model has been recalculated and reaggregated using the updated Estonian factor (This appears to have been completed).
